name: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation
summary: Hyderabad's city corporation, which maintains the city's roads inside the Outer Ring Road, including the Inner Ring Road.
ownership: Government of Telangana — urban local body
about: GHMC was created in 2007 when Hyderabad's municipal corporation absorbed the surrounding municipalities, bringing the whole built-up city under one body. It maintains the city's roads, flyovers and drains. The bigger regional projects around Hyderabad — the Outer Ring Road and the airport expressway — belong to the metropolitan development authority instead, so the two bodies divide the city's road network between them.
facts: Formed in 2007 by merging Hyderabad's corporation with twelve surrounding municipalities.
Maintains the Inner Ring Road and the city's flyovers and link roads.
The Outer Ring Road and airport expressway belong to the metropolitan development authority, not to GHMC.
Runs a public complaint service for potholes and road condition.

grievance.note: The corporation's site carries its civic complaint and pothole reporting channels.
